assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A uses subject "admin-a" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Import Map fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And the Import Map grid has record "301" owned by "FMO_ADMIN"
4. And the baseline fixture data defines "Module Name" as "container-076"
5. And the baseline fixture data defines "Path" as "https://fixture.example/case-076.js"
6. And the installed request interceptor defines "importMap.importMapId" as 202 on the next UI-originated Tile submission
7. And reference "202" belongs to "OTHER_ADMIN" while all remaining references belong to "FMO_ADMIN"
8. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Edit" in the Import Map grid row with "Record Id" "301"
9. Then the dialog titled "edit ID: 301" is visible on the Import Map administration page
10. When Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Module Name" with "container-076" in dialog "edit ID: 301"
11. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Path" with "https://fixture.example/case-076.js" in dialog "edit ID: 301"
12. And Admin A clicks the button labeled "Update" in dialog "edit ID: 301"
13. Then the alert with severity "error" in the portal snackbar contains the exact text "You do not have access to this record."
